translated_title: Mexico's Archaeology Institute Reveals Findings in the Mundo Zoque Cave in Cintalapa, Chiapas
original_title: INAH revela hallazgos en la cueva del mundo zoque en Cintalapa, Chiapas
author: Alonso Urrutia and Arturo Sánchez
meta_description: Twenty meters underground and 100 meters long, the Zoque pilgrimage cave in Chiapas has yielded 13 offerings and 179 pre-Hispanic pieces from the Late Classic period (600–900 AD).
